m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, handoff, G1 evidence, and the 0a primitives (cross_residual, offline_loader, db_truth_loader, contract, strawman_candidate, sector_anchor, covariance_gate). Verify the handoff is complete and DB sector truth resolves for the 6 sessions. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: context + primitives + G1 evidence loaded; handoff complete; DB GP-name mapping verified for all 6 sessions
postconditions.satisfied_by: Context, primitives, G1 evidence read; DB sector truth verified for all 6 sessions (Belgium/Spain/Great Britain/Brazil map cleanly, valid sector laps present)

m1-candidate.title: Raw-stream CandidateTrajectory builder + jitter/cadence helpers
m1-candidate.imperative: In scripts/characterize_timetag_jitter.py, build a CandidateTrajectory per driver from RAW car_data+pos_data (arc from pos X/Y in metres on pos grid; speed integrated from car_data interped onto pos grid), sliced per-lap from FastF1 LapStartTime/Time windows with DB lap_length. Add cadence-residual jitter helper. Smoke-run on ONE session and confirm the candidate validates and diagnose_cross_residual returns per-lap offsets.

postconditions.statement: candidate builds from raw streams for >=1 driver; cross_residual + cadence jitter run without error on one session (smoke)

constraints: raw streams only via offline_loader; NO get_telemetry; offline cache only; pos DECIMETRES x0.1->m; reuse 0a primitives, do not fork

m2-measures.title: Four measures + full run + per-session/aggregate JSON
m2-measures.imperative: Implement: (1) per-stream time-tag jitter distribution vs local cadence fit AND vs DB sector-crossing constraints; (2) error-model class {bias|random-walk|per-batch} with discriminating statistics (per-Source clustering, residual autocorrelation/drift, constant offset); (3) inter-stream offset stability via diagnose_cross_residual across all laps -> per-session mean, per-lap spread, autocorr/drift, arc-residual, stable/wander verdict; (4) reduced chi-square the covariance gate would see under measured noise. Emit per-session JSON (names contain jitter/offset) + aggregate. Full FOREGROUND run on real cache.

preconditions.statement: candidate builder + cadence helper working (m1 green)

postconditions.statement: full run over 6 sessions writes jitter/offset JSON + aggregate; headline numbers (jitter dist per stream, error-model class+statistic, per-session offset mean/spread/verdict, chi-square range) captured
